quotes.text:
WHAT:

Intro is an app for creating and sharing profiles (small websites representing a person, brand, business, etc).

Add photos, basic details, and anything else you want to share in a first impression. We’ll turn it into a simple, polished website, and viewers can message you through the app.

STATUS:

- Demo video here: https://x.com/heresmyintro/status/1978609089312596152

- Example sites available for business (https://heresmyintro.com/tires) and personal (https://heresmyintro.com/isabella)

- Available to try on iOS (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/heres-my-intro/id6749601914) and Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fourohseven.intro).

BACKGROUND:

We originally built Intro as a substitute for a phone number when dating, similar to Date Me profiles, but realized it might have a broader market as a website builder / digital business card creator. We think it has a level of simplicity and ease that could be applied to a broad number of use cases.

HOW YOU CAN HELP:

- Any feedback is greatly appreciated on design, positioning in the market, and how to get users. Thank you for checking us out!
- Reach out and follow us on X (https://x.com/heresmyintro). We’d love to talk to you.
